claims.reasoning: The KICKOFF invocation is a one-clause conditional gate ('this track touches existing code') that the operator/orchestrator must judge per-track before deciding whether to dispatch this skill alongside the other guard skills — it names none of the skill's internal methodology, safety contract, workflow steps, or catalogs. Per the classification rules this is conditional gating the operator must judge, i.e. load-bearing, not a restatement of the skill's own content even though it paraphrases the skill's own 'use when' trigger (that overlap is expected and desired for a gating clause).
